rationale: Hurricane Isaias makes landfall on US Gulf Coast with deaths and widespread power outages; Trump's Russia diesel deal faces rare Republican legal criticism.

top_events.title: Thousands without power in Florida and Alabama as Isaias moves north
top_events.label: Hurricane Isaias causes deaths and power outages
top_events.summary: Hurricane Isaias moved north after landfall, leaving at least four dead and thousands without power in Florida and Alabama, with flash flooding warnings extending into the Appalachians.

top_events.title: Republican senator says Trump diesel agreement with Russia may be illegal
top_events.label: Senator questions legality of Trump Russia deal
top_events.summary: A Republican senator raised legal concerns about President Trump's diesel agreement with Russia, which eases sanctions to lower fuel prices—marking rare criticism from within his own party.

top_events.title: US justice department investigates TV networks over Trump pool coverage
top_events.label: DOJ probes networks over Trump pool access
top_events.summary: The Justice Department is investigating TV networks after the White House blocked access for CNN, MS Now, and Politico, leading them to restrict pool coverage—continuing press access tensions.
